messages:
Maggie: Quick release-train update — shifting the v3.5 canary start from 03:00 UTC to 11:00 UTC. Observed an intermittent latency spike in the embeddings path during the soak. :warning:
Ajay: Ack. Do we have a root cause hypothesis?
Samir: Correlation with a quantization change batch (xformers kernel swap) in canary image. CPU fallback showed queueing.
Maggie: Yep. ML infra flagged increased kernel stall rate. We want extra time to validate a mitigant before exposing 5% traffic.
Ajay: Proposed mitigant: revert kernel selection to previous heuristic and re-run short soak. If stable, proceed.
Liz: If we push, can we restrict canary to low-cost lanes only (no real-time priority lane)?
Maggie: Good call — restrict to background lanes + disable priority routing for the canary. That buys safety while we validate.
Samir: Command I'll run now:```bash
redwood deploy start --model v3.5 --canary 5% --kernel heuristic-v2 --routes background-only
```
DeployBot: deploy-1963007790: Canary start initiated for v3.5 (5%) in us-west1, routes=background-only, kernel=heuristic-v2.
Noah: How long is the extended soak?
Maggie: We'll soak for 6h (instead of 2h). If p50/p95 tokens are within expected bounds and no regression alerts, we proceed to 25% tomorrow.
Ajay: I'll set up a short eval run against the embedding regression suite and watch quality metrics.
Samir: I'll monitor kernel stall counters and KV cache hit rate; I'll post a quick snapshot at +2h.
Maggie: Ops note: temporary freeze on any other model image changes in the release train until 18:00 UTC. This is scoped to images touching inference kernels. Non-image infra changes ok with release-approver.
Liz: Acknowledged. I'll update the release calendar + mention in the weekly changelog draft.
Noah: If the mitigant fails, are we rolling back to v3.4 fully?
Maggie: Yes — fallback plan is automated rollback to v3.4 and re-route priority lanes back to default. DeployBot will announce rollback.
DeployBot: monitor-1963007815: Canary health checks passing (initial). Latency p95 currently +4.8% vs baseline — within threshold.
Samir: +1 on current numbers. Keeping eyes on tail.
Maggie: Thanks everyone — please ack in-thread once you've read. I'll push a short summary to #release-notices after +2h if stable. :thumbsup:
Ajay: Ack.
Liz: Ack.
Noah: Ack.
Samir: Ack.
